hyperedges.label: Family entitlement pipeline (RevenueCat -> webhook -> family_plans -> entitlements)
Mobile UX Phase 1 - Safety and access

nodes.label: backend service
nodes.rationale: No ports exposed; only reachable via nginx in frontend container.

nodes.label: frontend service (Flutter web via nginx)
nodes.rationale: nginx proxies /api and /uploads; Cloudflare -> port 80.

nodes.label: purchases_flutter (RevenueCat)
nodes.rationale: Mobile-only; PurchaseService no-ops on web.

nodes.label: url_launcher for privacy/terms
nodes.rationale: Stores require privacy policy, Apple requires both reachable in-app for subscriptions (3.1.2).

nodes.label: Activity category + type model
nodes.rationale: care -> care|household|coverage; self -> sport|social|rest|appointment|other, always 0 coins; coverage only from personal-time accept.

nodes.label: payoutReasons (db/ledgerReasons.js)
nodes.rationale: Coverage files under its own reasons; never hard-code activity_completed/bounty_earned.

nodes.label: Backend tests with ordered mockClient
nodes.rationale: mockClient answers queries in order; update response lists when service query count changes.

nodes.label: P0 release blockers (INTERNET, cleartext, iOS Firebase, SHA-1, POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
nodes.norm_label: p0 release blockers (internet, cleartext, ios firebase, sha-1, post_notifications)

nodes.label: MyCareCoins Pro subscription terms
nodes.rationale: CareCoins have no monetary value; renewals and refunds handled by Apple/Google.

nodes.label: AppState (ChangeNotifier)
nodes.rationale: Single ChangeNotifier via provider; no router package

nodes.label: Admins cannot see inside families
nodes.rationale: /api/admin/* returns liveness and billing only; admin mutations write admin_audit_log in same transaction; test enforces it.

nodes.label: Append-only coin ledger
nodes.rationale: Never UPDATE/DELETE coin_ledger; undo via *_reverted reversal rows so SUM(amount) always equals family_members.coin_balance.

nodes.label: Every user-facing string in all four ARB files
nodes.norm_label: every user-facing string in all four arb files
nodes.rationale: No literals in widgets; ICU plurals must not contain bare #.

nodes.label: Idempotent schema migrations chained in init-db.js
nodes.norm_label: idempotent schema migrations chained in init-db.js
nodes.rationale: Production runs db:init on every container start, so migrations must be re-runnable.

nodes.label: Do not run dart format on whole files
nodes.norm_label: do not run dart format on whole files
nodes.rationale: Code is not formatter-clean; whole-file formatting creates huge diffs.

nodes.label: Personal-time declines never shown
nodes.rationale: Product decision (PRODUCT.md §15), not an omission.

nodes.label: Server-side authorization (requireRole/requireAdmin)
nodes.rationale: UI gating is cosmetic; authorization lives in middleware/rbac.js or service-level membership checks.

nodes.label: Two-layer coin economy (payouts + monthly residual)
nodes.rationale: Logging an activity moves coins from the monthly residual (distributionService) rather than creating them; real ceiling is totalGdp.

nodes.label: Dev-only cleartext HTTP opt-outs
nodes.rationale: Backend served over plain HTTP in dev; remove usesCleartextTraffic/NSAllowsArbitraryLoads once HTTPS.

nodes.label: assertFamilyWritable (402 on past_due)
nodes.rationale: Called before mutations because withTransaction only rolls back on throw.

nodes.label: Monthly coin distribution
nodes.rationale: last_coin_distribution_month is an idempotency guard so distribution runs once per month.

nodes.label: node --test with mock DB clients
nodes.rationale: Each service takes a client parameter so tests pass a mock client; no real DB needed.

nodes.label: Explicit activities are zero-sum against unclaimed residual
nodes.norm_label: explicit activities are zero-sum against unclaimed residual
nodes.rationale: Monthly GDP distribution means activities are not newly minted money; inflation concerns void.

nodes.label: Orphaned families (out of scope)
nodes.rationale: Admin cannot fix by editing roles; block last caregiver leaving instead

nodes.label: users.platform_role
nodes.rationale: Promoted only via CLI script, never via API

nodes.label: Retention sweep (notice -> wait -> delete)
nodes.rationale: Cleanup is a process, not a button; admin triggers, system touches data

nodes.label: Subscription data model (plans, family_plans, billing_events, admin_grants)
nodes.norm_label: subscription data model (plans, family_plans, billing_events, admin_grants)
nodes.rationale: Store truth and admin truth never overwrite each other

nodes.label: Platform Admin, Family Registry & Subscriptions Plan
nodes.norm_label: platform admin, family registry & subscriptions plan

nodes.label: Backend as single source of truth for entitlements
nodes.norm_label: backend as single source of truth for entitlements
nodes.rationale: Stores sell to a person, subscriptions belong to a family; only our API can unify cross-platform

nodes.label: Admin is the landlord, not a housemate
nodes.norm_label: admin is the landlord, not a housemate
nodes.rationale: Families are tenants; admin only has operational (alive?) and commercial (paid?) interests, served via aggregates

nodes.label: Provider swappability boundary
nodes.rationale: Only the Flutter purchase trigger and webhook consumer are RevenueCat-aware; data model provider-neutral

nodes.label: family_id subscriber attribute (replaced purchase intent)
nodes.rationale: One moving part instead of endpoint+storage+expiry

nodes.label: Entitlements (backend single source of truth)
nodes.rationale: Clients read /entitlements, never store SDK, so an iPhone purchase lights up Pro for Android family members; most generous wins

nodes.label: Family heartbeat (last_active_at)
nodes.rationale: Explicit column so admin API never touches content tables; success-only, throttled 1/hour

nodes.label: Read-only suspension gate (past_due -> 402)
nodes.rationale: Suspension is admin's strongest power; only past_due suspends; gate before mutations since withTransaction only rolls back on throw

nodes.label: absenceService (24h floor)
nodes.rationale: Below a day it is personal time, not time off

nodes.label: withTransaction
nodes.rationale: Every mutation atomic; rolls back only on throw

nodes.label: Service layer returning {data}|{error}
nodes.rationale: Business logic separated from HTTP; receives a transaction client so it is testable without HTTP

nodes.label: T2 Confirm before redeeming a reward
nodes.norm_label: t2 confirm before redeeming a reward

nodes.label: T3 Readable pill and card colours
nodes.norm_label: t3 readable pill and card colours

nodes.label: P0-3 Action pill colour contrast failures
nodes.norm_label: p0-3 action pill colour contrast failures

nodes.label: Phase 1 ground rules (branch, one commit per ticket, no dart format, 4 ARB files, Flutter only)
nodes.norm_label: phase 1 ground rules (branch, one commit per ticket, no dart format, 4 arb files, flutter only)
nodes.rationale: Whole-file formatting would turn small changes into huge diffs

nodes.label: Ink tokens (warningInk, successInk, primaryInk, dangerInk)
nodes.rationale: Soft fill -> ink text, never the base colour; hues kept, text darkened to >=4.5:1

nodes.label: Design system tokens (app_theme.dart)
nodes.rationale: Semantic-only palette: each colour has one job; WCAG AA, 44x44 targets, status never by colour alone

nodes.label: T1 Separate day-change gesture from swipe-to-remove
nodes.norm_label: t1 separate day-change gesture from swipe-to-remove

nodes.label: P0-1 Swipe changes day and deletes card
nodes.norm_label: p0-1 swipe changes day and deletes card
nodes.rationale: One primary gesture per region; move day nav to week strip

nodes.label: P1-1 Daily screen as Today tab
nodes.norm_label: p1-1 daily screen as today tab
nodes.rationale: Signature view used in brief high-stress moments should be top-level

nodes.label: P1-2 Needs you block
nodes.rationale: Finite, completable list gives the app a real end state

nodes.label: P1-3 Completion and undo invisible
nodes.rationale: Auto-complete sweep means users never mark done; checklist asks for non-existent action

nodes.label: P1-4 Key actions hidden behind gestures
nodes.norm_label: p1-4 key actions hidden behind gestures

nodes.label: P2 Polish (icons, skeletons, haptics, tokens, dark theme, deep links)
nodes.norm_label: p2 polish (icons, skeletons, haptics, tokens, dark theme, deep links)

nodes.label: D1 Tab set: Today, Family, Tasks, Rewards, Me
nodes.norm_label: d1 tab set: today, family, tasks, rewards, me
nodes.rationale: Five-item limit; Stats is monthly review, moved under Family

nodes.label: D2 Needs-you indicator is a dot only
nodes.norm_label: d2 needs-you indicator is a dot only

nodes.label: D3 Checklist step completes on first payout
nodes.norm_label: d3 checklist step completes on first payout

nodes.label: D4 Dark mode after token migration
nodes.norm_label: d4 dark mode after token migration

nodes.label: Guardrails from PRODUCT.md (no anxiety badges, coins not the point, declines invisible, colour not only signal)
nodes.norm_label: guardrails from product.md (no anxiety badges, coins not the point, declines invisible, colour not only signal)

nodes.label: Third-party consoles (Firebase, RevenueCat, Apple, Google Play)
nodes.norm_label: third-party consoles (firebase, revenuecat, apple, google play)

nodes.label: Fairness: personal time vs coverage given
nodes.norm_label: fairness: personal time vs coverage given

nodes.label: Plan catalog & subscriptions
nodes.rationale: Only past_due makes a family read-only; cancellations downgrade gracefully.

nodes.label: Brand vs product register
nodes.rationale: Landing is a brand surface (design is the product); app screens are product surfaces where design serves caregiving workflow.

nodes.label: Declines are never counted
nodes.rationale: Declining a personal-time ask is never surfaced in dashboard or stats, to avoid shaming.

nodes.label: Activity subclasses: care and self
nodes.rationale: Lets a self activity and its counter care activity occupy the same window.

nodes.label: Recurrence & expiry (Phase 6)
nodes.rationale: Requests go stale 48h after asking or when window starts.

nodes.label: Activity Subclasses, Personal Time & Coverage Plan
nodes.norm_label: activity subclasses, personal time & coverage plan

nodes.label: Presence-weighted residual
nodes.rationale: Conserves total, no new coin flow; absent caregiver's share shifts to present one.

nodes.label: Two settlement paths (24 h partition)
nodes.rationale: Absences ≥24h settle at month end without consent; self activities <24h settle immediately with consent.

nodes.label: Daily Timeline (signature component)
nodes.rationale: Primary mobile surface; prioritises speed and glanceability with NOW divider and gap indicators.

nodes.label: The Family Operations Room (creative north star)
nodes.norm_label: the family operations room (creative north star)

nodes.label: The Flat-By-Default Rule
nodes.rationale: Only interactive/responding surfaces earn shadows.

nodes.label: The One Job Rule (color semantics)
nodes.rationale: Every color keeps one semantic role; a new color is likely a state variation of an existing token.

nodes.label: The Weight-Or-Size Rule
nodes.rationale: Hierarchy via size not lighter weight; 800-weight headings read better in dense mobile UI.

nodes.label: flutter_localizations + ARB + gen-l10n
nodes.rationale: Typed getters make missing strings fail the build; ICU handles plurals; no third-party dependency.

nodes.label: How CareCoins works help sheet + glossary
nodes.norm_label: how carecoins works help sheet + glossary

nodes.label: Activation checklist
nodes.rationale: Teaches by doing; the core 7-step loop spans 5 tabs and invented vocabulary.

nodes.label: Automated tests (208 backend, 59 Flutter, no E2E)
nodes.norm_label: automated tests (208 backend, 59 flutter, no e2e)

nodes.label: Privacy boundary: admin is landlord not housemate
nodes.norm_label: privacy boundary: admin is landlord not housemate
nodes.rationale: platform_role separate axis; admin sees aggregates and billing only; allowlist + CI leak test

nodes.label: Starter tasks catalogue (client-side)
nodes.rationale: Catalogue lives in client so titles localize via AppLocalizations; server validates

nodes.label: Client-side localized starter packs
nodes.rationale: Default activities were DB rows in English unreachable by gen-l10n; moving them client-side lets them be localized.

nodes.label: P0-2 Redeem reward without confirmation
nodes.rationale: Confirm irreversible spending; other coin-moving actions already ask
